name: plants
about: Trees named by their scientific (binomial) names: conifers and broadleaf trees of the world

names.name: Nothotsuga longibracteata
names.note: bristlecone hemlock: a rare conifer of southern China

names.name: Chamaecyparis lawsoniana
names.note: Lawson's cypress: a tall conifer of Oregon and California

names.name: Chamaecyparis nootkatensis
names.note: Nootka cypress: a conifer of the Pacific coast of North America

names.name: Metasequoia glyptostroboides
names.note: dawn redwood: a conifer of China that drops its needles in autumn

names.name: Sequoiadendron giganteum
names.note: giant sequoia: a very large conifer of the Sierra Nevada

names.name: Taiwania cryptomerioides
names.note: Taiwania: a tall conifer of Taiwan and southern China

names.name: Dacrycarpus dacrydioides
names.note: kahikatea: a tall conifer of the wet forests of New Zealand

names.name: Sciadopitys verticillata
names.note: umbrella-pine: a Japanese conifer with its needles in rings

names.name: Schinus terebinthifolius
names.note: Brazilian pepper tree: an evergreen tree of South America

names.name: Toxicodendron vernicifluum
names.note: Chinese lacquer tree: its sap gives the lacquer of East Asia

names.name: Handroanthus impetiginosus
names.note: purple tabebuia: a tree of the Americas with pink to purple flowers

names.name: Adansonia madagascariensis
names.note: Madagascar baobab: a baobab tree of Madagascar

names.name: Casuarina cunninghamiana
names.note: Cunningham beefwood: an Australian river tree with thin, needle-like twigs

names.name: Cercidiphyllum japonicum
names.note: katsura: a tree of Japan and China with round, heart-shaped leaves

names.name: Dalbergia congestifloria
names.note: kingwood: a rosewood tree; its wood has the trade name kingwood

names.name: Enterolobium cyclocarpum
names.note: elephant-ear tree: a large tree of Central America with ear-shaped pods

names.name: Chrysolepis chrysophylla
names.note: golden chinquapin: an evergreen tree of the Pacific coast, its leaves golden below

names.name: Lithocarpus cleistocarpus
names.note: stoneoak: an evergreen tree of China, a relative of the oaks

names.name: Artocarpus heterophyllus
names.note: jackfruit: a tropical tree with very large fruits

names.name: Artocarpus odoratissimus
names.note: marang: a tree of Borneo with sweet fruits

names.name: Eucalyptus camaldulensis
names.note: red river gum: an Australian gum tree that grows along rivers

names.name: Psidium friedrichsthalianum
names.note: Costa Rica guava: a guava tree of Central America

names.name: Pittosporum rhombifolium
names.note: Queensland pittosporum: an Australian tree with orange berries

names.name: Reynosia septentrionalis
names.note: darling plum: a small tree of Florida and the Caribbean

names.name: Lyonothamnus floribundus
names.note: Catalina ironwood: a tree of the islands off southern California

names.name: Mastichodendron foetidissimum
names.note: mastic: a tall tree of Florida and the Caribbean

names.name: Cupaniopsis anacardioides
names.note: tuckeroo: a tree of the coasts of eastern Australia

names.name: Chrysophyllum oliviforme
names.note: satinleaf: a tree of Florida and the Caribbean, its leaves copper below

names.name: Stewartia pseudocamellia
names.note: Japanese stewartia: a tree with flowers like a camellia and peeling bark
